verdict.rationale: Docusign ships a broad REST API and SDKs (esign-rest-api, Node client, OpenAPI specs) covering core send/sign/template/status workflows, and community reports confirm smooth embedded-signing API use, but many newer UI-centric capabilities (drag-and-drop CLM workflow builder, AI-Assisted Review's Word plugin, Web Forms visual editor) are described only as UI features with no evidence of equivalent API coverage. One community report (docusign-comm-1) also describes a case where the modern API lacked a needed capability, forcing a fallback to a legacy version — a concrete gap in API/UI parity. missing for 10: explicit documentation of API parity for CLM workflow builder, AI-Assisted Review, and Web Forms editor; independent confirmation that no UI-only features exist.
